display_name: GraniteShares 2x Short SK Hynix Daily ETF

about.en: SKDD is the GraniteShares 2x Short SK Hynix Daily ETF, a leveraged inverse single-stock exchange-traded fund listed on Nasdaq that seeks minus two times (-200%) the daily percentage change of the shares of SK Hynix Inc., the South Korean memory-chip maker, before fees and expenses. Because the exposure resets daily, returns over periods longer than one day can differ substantially from minus twice the share's performance.
